Being “double-jointed” isn’t harmless!

Welcome! I’m Dr. Linda Bluestein, an EDS patient & physician specializing in Ehlers-Danlos Syndromes & related disorders. I founded Hypermobility MD & Bendy Bodies to challenge outdated narratives & give people real answers, not dismissal.

Connective tissue disorders often mean chronic pain, repeated injuries, fatigue, autonomic symptoms, & bodies that don’t behave the way medicine expects them to. This channel exists to make sense of that complexity.

Each week, I share myth-busters, expert interviews, & practical strategies for managing pain, joint instability, fatigue, POTS, MCAS, & more. These conversations bridge science & lived experience—& remind us that being hard to diagnose is not the same as being difficult.

Subscribe & turn on notifications so you don’t miss anything.
